name: Eurofins Scientific SE
summary: Eurofins Scientific SE, together with its subsidiaries, provides various analytical testing and laboratory services worldwide. It provides services, such as agroscience, including biological assessment, consumer and human, environmental safety, product chemistry, regulatory consultancy, and seed services; agro testing; assurance, including sustainability, audit, certification, quality inspection, QA-QC programme, and food and dietary supplement labelling services; biopharma, and clinical diagnostics.
